text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease. The history of a unilateral resting tremor worsening over one year, combined with cognitive decline (memory issues), is classic for Parkinson's disease. The reading difficulty suggests evolving bradykinesia. We should confirm this with a neurological exam focusing on rigidity and gait, and consider imaging only if atypical features arise.
